title: Procedural turned object from a lathe profile
summary: A 48-point profile (waist plus a cosine ripple faded by `sin πt`, so the ends meet the faces) through `LatheGeometry`, closed by two `RingGeometry` faces and a bored lathe; one self-contained map builder stringified into a Blob `Worker` (1.5 s deadline) and reused as the same-thread fallback (`?worker=0`); after a `250 ms` dwell, a mouse under `(pointer: fine)` gets one quantised revolution set exactly to `(n + 1)·2π`; frames only while turning; tint without a turn under reduced motion, drawn once in the static tier
variants: Spool: rippled waist profile, ring faces, bore (this)
Disc: very short profile, wide RingGeometry faces, a hub lathe
Label band: a straight lathe cylinder over a product photograph
Maps on the main thread only: ?worker=0
